original_query: What is the title of the presentation that ALCATEL-LUCENT made for the OVERVIEW of 2012?

summaries.summary: The search result shows the title slide of a presentation titled 'ALCATEL-LUCENT OVERVIEW 2012'. The slide features a photograph of a person walking on a path with mountains and a lake in the background, overlaid with the text 'AT THE SPEED OF IDEAS'. The Alcatel-Lucent logo is visible at the bottom right.
